Ammo Types Available: Bullets
Cost: 40eb for 10

When firing this Ammo in Stealth, enemies receive -2 to Perception checks made against the user. When used against an enemy with SP11 or lower while in stealth, this ammunition can trigger an instant stealth kill as long as the target is within 6 meters (3 squares) of the user. When used outside this range or against an enemy with SP12+, this ammo does damage as normal and drops the lowest rolled damage die.

Replaces: Subsonic Ammunition (Corgo's 77 Collection)

Foundry notes:

  • The stealth kill and the dropped damage die are not automated.

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Ammo).
